description: Entities and typed relations between them, usually with a schema (ontology) and the sources of each fact, queried by traversal or pattern matching.
A question whose answer chains several facts, often from different sources, such as supplier to part to product.
A formal vocabulary of classes, relations and constraints that every writer of a graph shares.
Merging mentions of the same real-world thing ("Acme Corp.", "ACME Corporation") into one node.
Retrieval over an entity graph and pre-computed community summaries, so whole-corpus questions can be answered.
Shared business definitions (metrics, entities, dimensions) served to BI tools, APIs and agents so one word means one thing.
The questions a knowledge system must answer; they scope the ontology and the retrieval design.
